profile.description: Abraj Energy Services SAOG, an integrated energy company, provides oilfield and well services in Oman and Kuwait. It operates through Drilling and Work Over and Well Services and Others segments. The company provides onshore drilling, workover, flowback, well testing and intervention, cementing, fracturing, coil tubing, integrated project management, drilling fluid, and training services. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Muscat, Oman. Abraj Energy Services SAOG operates as a subsidiary of OQ SAOC.
